definitions.registered: Canonical unmerged accounts, with founder account counted separately. Every non-founder must have an admission marker. An account is not active use.
definitions.human_message: A direct text after admission from a canonical admitted member to their own lore - founder, groups, previews and automation excluded. Any human text counts: sign-ups, short replies, complaints and opt-outs included. Deleted history is not reconstructed; historical activity may change after a member reset.
definitions.windows: Last 24 hours and last 168 hours are exact elapsed-time windows ending at the snapshot time. Daily charts use Pacific calendar days; the current day is partial.
definitions.completed_day_growth: Previous completed Pacific day only; non-founder denominator. This is not the average daily growth field.

compound_average_daily_growth.definition: Compound average daily change in canonical non-founder account count over completed Pacific calendar days. Not a claim about each day or a forecast.
